model: PURE Control - VSRT Steam Boiler Single (N54 ProtoNode)
applies_to: Fulton VSRT steam boilers with the PURE control, one boiler per address block on the N54 ProtoNode.
summary: Fulton's N54 ProtoNode publishes 47 objects for each boiler (one block of objects per boiler), for VSRT steam boilers with the PURE control. It covers burner state, modulation, steam pressures, safety switch states and alarms. The BMS can enable the boiler, send a pressure setpoint and a heartbeat, and supply outdoor and header values when the boiler is set up for them.
notes: Object IDs are written (X)001-(X)058, where (X) is the boiler's Modbus address on the ProtoNode. This list shows boiler address 1 (1001-1058); boiler 2 uses 2001-2058.
The sheet does not say which BACnet transport the gateway is set to; ProtoNode gateways are normally configured for BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP.
The BMS Enable point only works after a physical jumper is removed at the boiler.
Outdoor and header AVs marked Note 1 are writable only when the boiler program is set to take that value from the BMS.
Current Alarm Index is decoded with Fulton's alarm chart and is only valid while Active Alarm = 1.
Object (X)020 has the range "0.0 to 200.0" printed in its name column; the Provider sheet names the same ID Start Pressure. The name is kept as printed.

integration.summary: Remove the BMS enable jumper at the boiler, write BMS Enable = 1, send the pressure setpoint to BMS Network Setpoint and keep writing 1 to BMS Heartbeat at least every 10 s. Check that Current Setpoint Mode reads BMS Network (3), then read status, outlet pressure, modulation rate and the alarm points.

minimum_points.name: Boiler 1 BMS Enable
minimum_points.why: Network enable; jumper must be removed first

minimum_points.name: Boiler 1 BMS Heartbeat
minimum_points.why: Write 1 at least every 10 s for remote operation

minimum_points.name: Boiler 1 Current Alarm Index
minimum_points.why: Alarm number from Fulton's alarm chart

integration.enable: Remove the physical jumper at the boiler, then write BV (X)057 BMS Enable = 1. The setpoint comes from AV (X)052 BMS Network Setpoint (0-200 psi); AI (X)051 Current Setpoint Mode reads 3 when the network setpoint is in use.
integration.heartbeat: AV (X)058 BMS Heartbeat: the BMS must write 1 at least once every 10 seconds for remote operation. What the boiler does when the heartbeat stops is not stated on this sheet.
integration.remote_sensors: AV (X)025 outdoor air temperature (°F) and AV (X)026 common header supply pressure (psi) are writable only when the boiler program is set to take that value from the BMS.
setup: Object ID = boiler Modbus address followed by the three-digit point number: (X)001-(X)058. Boiler 1 = 1001-1058, boiler 2 = 2001-2058.
The sheet gives no device instance, MAC address or baud rate; those are set on the ProtoNode gateway.
gotchas: BMS Enable does nothing until the physical jumper is removed.
Safety BIs mostly read 0 = Fault, 1 = No Fault; the low water BIs read 1 = Fault.
